notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-11-06, b4676 — the fourteenth cut — addresses learn at their core, no fuzzy rewriting of real words, nothing starts while your text is landing, FluidAudio 0.18.2, notarized): (1) Your email and web-address corrections now count toward one target however the speech model misspelled it: the pairs the app already holds are folded to their core (an email's local part, an address's stem) when the app starts, so three corrections of one address arm it, and a learned core fixes the address in any form — upperviewsimui.com becomes upperviewsamui.com once upperviewsamui is learned. (2) The dictionary's fuzzy matching never rewrites a phrase of real English words any more: "made so" stays "made so" even though a places entry "Mae Sot" sounds alike; an entry still applies when its exact spoken form is said. (3) The speech engine library moves to FluidAudio 0.18.2: it repairs gaps at window seams, joins words split across a window, and recovers dropped opening speech on i
